setup.title: Get connected
setup.tzNotice: You’re away from home — tap to finish connecting your Jum eSIM.
setup.previewNote: Deep links to system settings only work on a real device — follow the written steps below.

install.title: Install your eSIM
install.why: The eSIM profile must exist on this device before anything else works.
install.ios: Open the QR from your confirmation email, or Settings → Cellular → Add eSIM and enter the LPA string manually.
install.android: Settings → Network → SIM manager → Add eSIM → scan the QR or paste the LPA string.

line_on.title: Turn on your Jum e-SIM line
line_on.why: New eSIM lines ship turned off — flip the line on once and it stays on.
line_on.ios: Settings → Cellular → your Jum e-SIM line → turn it ON.
line_on.android: Settings → Network → SIMs → Jum e-SIM → turn it ON.

roaming.title: Enable Data Roaming on the Jum line only
roaming.why: Travel eSIMs require roaming ON for this line. Your home SIM can stay off — no surprise bills.
roaming.ios: Settings → Cellular → Jum e-SIM → Data Roaming → ON.
roaming.android: Settings → Network → SIMs → Jum e-SIM → Roaming → ON.

data_line.title: Set Jum e-SIM as your Cellular Data line
data_line.why: Only one line can carry data — point it at the travel eSIM.
data_line.ios: Settings → Cellular → Cellular Data → select Jum e-SIM.
data_line.android: Settings → Network → SIMs → Preferred SIM for mobile data → Jum e-SIM.

apn.title: (Only if needed) APN: “jum”
apn.why: Most networks set the APN automatically — only touch this if the connection test still fails.
apn.ios: Settings → Cellular → Jum e-SIM → Cellular Data Network → APN = jum.
apn.android: Settings → Network → SIMs → Jum e-SIM → Access Point Names → New APN, name jum, APN jum → Save → Select.

test.title: Test connection
test.why: Pings Jum through your data line so you know it really works — not just “should work”.

setup.youllSee: You’ll see Jum e-SIM at the top.
setup.openFailed: Couldn’t open Settings automatically — go to:
setup.balanceNote: Data balance is tracked in My eSIMs.
setup.fixesIntro: Work through these in order — each one ends with Retest so you always know where you stand.

airplane.label: No signal
airplane.detail: Airplane mode ON for 10 seconds → OFF → wait 60 seconds → Retest.

roaming_toggle.label: Signal but no data
roaming_toggle.detail: Toggle Data Roaming OFF then ON again on the Jum line → Retest.

network_select.label: Still nothing
network_select.detail: Settings → Network Selection → switch Auto/Manual and pick another partner network → Retest.

apn_manual.label: APN missing
apn_manual.detail: Add APN “jum” on the Jum line exactly as in step 5 → Retest.
